text:
Maya: FYI I just got a flight delay — looks like I won't make the 20:00 UTC handoff window in person. I can still be primary remotely until 21:30 UTC but won't be on mobile reliably after that. can anyone pick up primary from 21:30-02:00?

Alex: I can take 21:30-00:30 if that helps. I’ll be near my laptop til midnight. @Maya do you want me to take pager now or at 21:30? :thumbsup:

Maya: Alex please take at 21:30. I’ll remain primary until then and will forward any open notifications. leaving a quick checklist below.

Maya: Runbook pointers: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/primary-handoff (see "late-handback" section). Quick actions: 1) confirm pager transfer, 2) ensure canary routing policy set to fallback->small-model for embeds (if latency recurs), 3) notify support triage channel if customer-facing errors > 10% 5m.

OpsBot: incident-bot: INCIDENT-2026-03-16-EMBEDS latency spike 10:15-10:40 UTC — resolved. No active incidents. Pager queue length: 0.

Leon: I can shadow and be secondary until 02:00 — happy to take escalations after Alex's slot ends. Will keep phone on.

Alex: OK taking primary at 21:30. tagging this as planned handoff. I'll run the transfer command ~21:28 so the pager rebind is clean.

Sara: quick Q — is there any customer impact right now we should escalate to CS? Ben was monitoring earlier.

Ben: No ongoing customer impact per monitoring; post-mortem traces show the embed rate limit burst + long tails from a single corp tenant. We throttled and rerouted; no SLO breach. I'll ping account team for the one noisy tenant to do rate-limiting follow-up.

Priya: If Alex is taking primary at 21:30, who should I list on the Dedicated capacity rotation for midnight patch window? I can shift the patch to 02:30 if needed.

Maya: Leon will be secondary until 02:00; after Alex ends at 00:30 Leon takes primary or we can flip again. If patch needs to be during primary ownership, please coordinate with Alex.

Leon: I can promote to primary at 00:30 if Alex wants to hand off then. Alex — prefer me to take at 00:30 or do you want until 00:00 then handoff?

Alex: 00:30 works. I'll set an alarm to do the handoff.

Sara: leaving the runbook snippet that helped earlier (copy here for quick access):
```
# switch primary (CLI)
redwood oncall transfer --from Maya --to Alex --at 2026-03-16T21:30:00Z
# verify routing
redwood routing get --policy embeds --env prod
```

Maya: 👍 exact. Also check `redwood telemetry tail --filter embed.latency>200` for immediate alerts after handoff.

OpsBot: pagerbot: Pager rebind scheduled at 2026-03-16T21:28:00Z. Reminder will be posted ~2m before.

Ben: tagging CS: @support-team: no active customer outages, but watch for post-handoff noise for the next 6h. If anything > 5% error rate for >5m escalate to SEV1.

Alex: done — I confirmed pager bind at 21:30Z and validated `heartbeat` from the phone. I also checked the routing policy; fallback model is set.

Maya: thanks @Alex. I'm on plane wifi but reachable. leaving the emergency escalation checklist here: 1) if latency > 15% of requests, toggle canary off for embeds, 2) if token auth errors spike, check KMS key rotation logs (`/var/log/kms-rotate.log`), 3) escalate to infra oncall if GPU pool errors show OOM >2 nodes.

Leon: I’m watching dashboards, will take over primary at 00:30 if no changes.

Priya: scheduling note: moving midnight patch to 02:30 to avoid the handoff window. I’ll update the dedicated-capacity calendar and post in #eng-releases.

Maya: appreciate it. leaving final note: please add any handoff oddities to the oncall journal (link in runbook) — I’ll fill in incident notes once I land. Safe handoffs everyone. :airplane:

Alex: copying into journal now. Good luck Maya.

Leon: thanks — standing by.

OpsBot: incident-bot: handoff completed. participants: Maya->Alex@2026-03-16T21:30Z, planned Alex->Leon@2026-03-17T00:30Z.

Ben: +1 documented.

Sara: thanks team.

Maya: last message from me: phone battery low, ping me only for SEV1. See you all later.
